claims.explanation: Thiocolchicoside exerts anticancer effects via tubulin binding and NF-κB downregulation, with GABA receptor antagonism contributing to its activity. Sensitivity is enriched in lines with mutations in chromatin/NF-κB coactivators (EP300, KMT2C, ARID1A) and PI3K/MAPK/DDR pathways (PIK3CA, BRAF, ATM), while CTNNB1/SF3B1 mutations and high TUBB3 expression may confer resistance. Expression of GABA receptor subunits may also predict sensitivity.
